    N = rhs.shape[1]
    K = lhsT.shape[0]

    # Copy result from PSUM to sbuf

    psum_tile = nl.ndarray((tile_shape[0], tile_shape[1]), dtype=nl.float32, buffer=nl.psum)
    
    for m in nl.affine_range(tile_count[0]):

            nisa.tensor_copy(dst=out[start_m:start_m + tile_shape[0], start_n:start_n + tile_shape[1]], src=psum_tile)
    return out
